# Work Item Plan
## Work Item WI-001: Backend levels API and static hosting
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: Backend levels API and static hosting
- kind: backend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 服务以可注入数据路径、静态根目录和 port 0 启动 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在临时同源地址提供关卡 API 与静态托管并支持确定性停止。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法逻辑。
- non_goals: 不引入 npm 依赖、数据库、认证或外部服务。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: []
### Inputs
### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-BACKEND-RUNTIME-V1
- capabilities: createServer(options) accepts dataPath and staticRoot
- capabilities: start accepts port 0 and resolves object with origin port and stop
- capabilities: stop returns Promise
- capabilities: GET / serves configured staticRoot page entry
- capabilities: static paths resolve within configured staticRoot using Node path primitives
- capabilities: static missing paths return 404 text response
- contract_id: CT-LEVELS-API-V1
- capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 JSON array of exactly 5 levels
- capabilities: level id is nonempty string unique within file
- capabilities: level name is nonempty string
- capabilities: level difficulty is one of 简单 普通 困难
- capabilities: level unlocked is boolean
- capabilities: success responses use Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- capabilities: invalid level data returns 500 error code LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE
- capabilities: API errors use structured JSON error object with readable message
- capabilities: API errors use Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- capabilities: unknown API paths return 404 JSON error
- capabilities: unsupported API methods return 405 JSON error
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN 后端工作项进入实现 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 tests/backend 中以 node --test 先覆盖生命周期、API 成功与错误、静态夹具路由和路径边界。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN 准备生产关卡数据 THE SYSTEM SHALL 创建包含恰好 5 个合法关卡对象的 data/levels.json。
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN 实现服务与数据读取 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用 node:http node:fs node:path 提供 createServer start stop、GET /api/levels、静态路由、路径安全解析和统一错误语义。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-003
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: server/**
- exclusive_scopes: data/levels.json
- exclusive_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN createServer 与 start 以 port 0、自定义 dataPath 和 staticRoot 被调用 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回实际 loopback origin、port 和可完成的 stop 并在测试夹具上完成路由。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN GET /api/levels 读取合法数据文件 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 200 JSON 数组、恰好 5 个关卡和满足约束的 id name difficulty unlocked 字段。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-003
- statement: WHEN 数据文件缺失不可读无法解析或字段结构不合法 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 500 与 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE 的 JSON 错误契约。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-004
- statement: WHEN API 路径方法异常或静态夹具路径越界缺失 THE SYSTEM SHALL 分别返回 API JSON 404/405 或静态 404 文本响应并阻止静态根目录外读取。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: node --test tests/backend
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: contract_id
- required_fields: provider_logical_work_item_id
- required_fields: capabilities
- required_fields: acceptance_result
- provided_contract_refs: CT-BACKEND-RUNTIME-V1
- provided_contract_refs: CT-LEVELS-API-V1
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-001
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-002
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-004
### Blockers
### Traceability
- source_type: design_spec
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: NFR-001
- source_type: design_spec
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-002
- source_type: design_spec
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-003
- source_type: design_spec
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-004
## Work Item WI-002: Native level selection page
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: Native level selection page
- kind: frontend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 玩家打开静态关卡选择页 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以原生页面脚本渲染关卡名称难度和锁定态并在请求或响应异常时保留页面框架与可读错误提示。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现浏览器自动化或关卡玩法逻辑。
- non_goals: 不引入 npm 依赖、前端框架、认证或外部服务。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001
### Inputs
- contract_id: CT-LEVELS-API-V1
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 JSON array of exactly 5 levels
- required_capabilities: level id is nonempty string unique within file
- required_capabilities: level name is nonempty string
- required_capabilities: level difficulty is one of 简单 普通 困难
- required_capabilities: level unlocked is boolean
- required_capabilities: success responses use Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- required_capabilities: API errors use structured JSON error object with readable message
- compatibility_policy: require_all
### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-LEVEL-PAGE-V1
- capabilities: web/index.html exposes id=loading
- capabilities: web/index.html exposes id=level-list
- capabilities: web/index.html exposes id=error-message
- capabilities: web/index.html loads web/level-select.js as module
- capabilities: web/level-select.js exports initLevelSelect accepting document and fetchImpl
- capabilities: initLevelSelect validates array responses before rendering
- capabilities: initLevelSelect renders level name and difficulty from valid data
- capabilities: initLevelSelect applies locked state when unlocked is false
- capabilities: initLevelSelect preserves page frame and shows readable error on failure
- capabilities: web/level-select.js references relative path /api/levels
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN 前端工作项进入实现 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 tests/frontend 中以 node --test 和 DOM 替身先覆盖容器标记、模块接口、成功渲染、锁定态和错误分支。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-005
- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN 构建页面骨架 THE SYSTEM SHALL 创建 web/index.html 并提供 loading level-list error-message 三个容器和 level-select.js 模块引用。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-005
- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN 页面脚本处理 GET /api/levels 响应 THE SYSTEM SHALL 校验数组结构后使用安全文本渲染名称难度与锁定态或在失败时保留容器并显示可读错误。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-006
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: web/**
- exclusive_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-005
- statement: WHEN 检查 web/index.html 与 web/level-select.js THE SYSTEM SHALL 确认三容器标记、模块脚本、initLevelSelect 注入接口和相对 API 路径存在。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-006
- statement: WHEN DOM 替身收到合法五项响应 THE SYSTEM SHALL 渲染名称难度并对 unlocked=false 项目呈现锁定不可选择状态。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-007
- statement: WHEN DOM 替身模拟请求失败非成功状态或结构无效响应 THE SYSTEM SHALL 进入错误分支保留基本页面框架并显示可读错误提示。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: node --test tests/frontend
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: contract_id
- required_fields: provider_logical_work_item_id
- required_fields: capabilities
- required_fields: acceptance_result
- provided_contract_refs: CT-LEVEL-PAGE-V1
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-005
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-006
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-007

- source_type: design_spec
- source_id: design_spec_0001
